scripts.predev: echo '🧹 Cleaning up existing processes...' && make dev-stop-services > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SHORTS,MARKET-DATA,ENRICHMENT,FRONTEND,STRIPE" -c "yellow,magenta,green,cyan,blue" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:market-data" "npm run dev:enrichment-processor" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:stripe"
scripts.dev:no-stripe: concurrently -n "SHORTS,MARKET-DATA,ENRICHMENT,FRONTEND" -c "yellow,magenta,green,cyan" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:market-data" "npm run dev:enrichment-processor" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:stripe: command -v stripe >/dev/null 2>&1 && stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3020/api/stripe/webhook || echo '💳 Stripe CLI not installed - skipping webhook forwarding'
scripts.test: npm run test:workflow && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
